description: A luminous, California-warm bathroom vanity scene with a spa-like elegance. The vanity counter is Calacatta or Carrara marble in white with soft grey veining. An undermount rectangular sink sits centered, with a bridge-style or widespread faucet in polished or brushed brass with gently tapered spout. On the counter surface, a stack of neatly folded white Turkish cotton towels sits at the left, alongside a small natural sea sponge, a row of amber glass skincare bottles, and a small terracotta-potted herb or succulent. The vanity cabinet below is painted in creamy antique white with recessed panel details. The background wall is smooth warm cream plaster. A large round mirror with a thin matte-brass frame is centered above the sink. On either side of the mirror, elongated oval or pill-shaped frosted alabaster or opal glass forms with brass canopy fittings are mounted vertically, each emitting a soft diffused warm glow that spreads gently across the plaster wall flanking the mirror. Natural light enters from a window to the right, casting a warm golden diagonal wash across the plaster. Camera at standing eye-level, centered symmetrical composition on the vanity mirror wall, normal lens, level pitch, tight vignette. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category. Render the fixture exactly per the reference image — preserve all proportions, materials, finishes, and design details.
